description: Use when a person asks how pooling and benefit sharing work in a conservation co-op, or when you need a valid starting scenario for prepare_pooling_draft. Do not use it for real figures, prices or eligibility: every member, quantity and amount is synthetic. Takes no input. Returns a fictional three-member scenario and its modeled result (ecological reserve, sale, stewardship and treasury shares and each member's allocation in cents), with status flags showing nothing was executed, verified, issued or paid, plus a source receipt and the vergecommon.com calculator page.
name: example_pooling_draft
